# PLAN — iteration 3

## Current state assessment

The 7-LUT, 9-FF incumbent is already timing-feasible at WNS 0.553 ns and WHS 0.135 ns, so this iteration needs a strict LUT reduction to improve the objective. The prior 8-bit natural-wrap attempt used 10 LUTs, and the comparator rewrite used 8; neither improved on the incumbent. The top’s numeric latency is unknown, so no numeric annotation is required.

## Hypothesis

Replacing the incrementer and terminal-count mux with explicit low-bit toggle equations may reduce LUT use by expressing the modulo-256 count directly, while preserving its cycle sequence.

## Instruction for generator

Keep the module interface, 32-bit `counter` declaration, reset branch, and registered `pwm_out` comparison unchanged. Replace only the non-reset counter update with per-bit toggle equations for `counter[7:0]`: bit 0 toggles every cycle, and bit *i* toggles when all lower bits are one; assign `counter[31:8]` to zero on each non-reset cycle. This removes the explicit `counter == 255` branch, but may map worse than Vivado’s current incrementer, so retain the candidate only if all gates pass and routed LUT use is strictly below 7.
